# Indexed gray4 image fixture

`target-indexed-gray4.png` is a synthetic 800 × 480 noninterlaced 2-bit indexed
PNG with four opaque ascending gray entries. Generated by
`examples/http-get/renderer.py` using `png(indexed=True)`. It exercises accepted
indexed output alongside the [grayscale fixture](../phase0/README.md); it is not
evidence of physical-device acceptance.
